primary_sources.author: George Lasry
primary_sources.title: A Methodology for the Cryptanalysis of Classical Ciphers with Search Metaheuristics
primary_sources.finding: Defines equal-length non-overlapping segment swaps, segment slides, and the staged random-pool/left-to-right/IDP-HC/K1-q3/final-K2-q3 attack. Names 3-partite swaps but text examined does not explicitly map them.

primary_sources.author: CrypTool 2 Team
primary_sources.finding: Cycles of three disjoint equal-length segments of length1..3 in both directions; all three-distinct-point cycles; circular slides with wrap. Comment refers to original Lasry. Current shared ADFGVX source is not evidence of an identical historical 2014 executable.

primary_sources.author: CrypTool 2 Team
primary_sources.finding: ADFGVX invokes slides=true,swaps=true,inversions=true and randomizes its list. Phase4 intentionally tests the selected non-inverting families with inversions=false.

port_choices.key_representation: source numerical s[plaintext_column]=read_rank; cryptographic boundary inverse(s)
port_choices.mapping: C# stores inverse(temp) and assigns to[list[i]]=from[i]; net candidate equals from[temp[destination]]. Independent Python simulation verifies entire candidate sets for widths3..25.
port_choices.identity: Original includes one identity; phase4 retains it only in geometry and excludes it from strict-improvement search.
port_choices.bounds: Literal source segment swaps limited to w//4, with strict p2<w−len; three-block sizes1..3 use strict endpoints. No silent boundary correction.
port_choices.shuffle: std::shuffle uniform permutation each HC sweep replaces source randomize() successive random swaps; this and its cadence are explicit variants.
port_choices.scoring_and_initialization: Immutable phase3 IDP and K1; same pool1000/keep20/climbs5, left-to-right seed stream, 3outer rounds, q3 selection, and matched walltime/evaluation limits. No planted truth in search.
port_choices.source_vs_old: Neither candidate set contains the other; geometry_check.json records both set differences.
